messages:
Olivia (Finance): Heads up: batch_20260325_03 produced duplicate invoices for a handful of customers. Example: acct 90777 has INV-90777-20260325 and INV-90777-20260325-b; the latter is missing reserved compute line items and totals are off.

Jan (Billing Eng): Which batch and sample invoice id? Ill grab generator logs.

Olivia (Finance): batch_20260325_03, sample acct 90777. Invoice b shows only seats/subscriptions. No gpu_hours lines.

InvoiceBot: [system] invoice_generator v2.16 job_20260325_03_1 ERROR shard_hash_drift detected for acct=90777. Created provisional INV-90777-20260325-b (status: issued).

Jan (Billing Eng): That error means rate_key hashing changed during a recent deploy; negative credit rows and usage rows ended up in different hash buckets so merge treated them as separate invoices.

Ravi (RevOps): Support already has two tickets. Customers worried about double charges. We need to reissue and notify.

Hannah (Acct Mgr): Finance, do we need approval to void the erroneous invoice before reissue?

Olivia (Finance): Approve void + credit memo + reissue for impacted accounts in this batch. Net effect expected to be 0. Also recommend we pause auto-issue when shard_hash_drift triggers.

Jan (Billing Eng): Plan: 1) run small scanner to list accounts with shard_hash_drift in batch_20260325_03, 2) dry-run reintegration to confirm combined lines, 3) create credit memos and issue reissued invoices with note "reissued due to shard_hash_drift". Command: `billing_repair --batch batch_20260325_03 --fix shard_hash_drift --dry-run`

InvoiceBot: [system] ticket created: BIL-8995 (investigate shard_hash_drift + auto-issue guard).

Jan (Billing Eng): Dry-run shows 6 affected accounts. I'll hold apply until recon CSV attached and finance signs off.

Olivia (Finance): Signed off. Please attach reconciliation CSV and customer note template once done.

Hannah (Acct Mgr): Will draft customer note: brief apology, explanation that internal hashing changed, confirmation net impact 0, new invoice id.

Jan (Billing Eng): Applied fixes after approvals. Created credit memos for the provisional invoices and reissued consolidated invoices. Uploading recon report to shared bucket now.

Olivia (Finance): Thank you. Please include the list of affected accounts in the BIL-8995 postmortem and add a metric alert for shard_hash_drift.

Ravi (RevOps): Noted. Closing loop once postmortem is in.

InvoiceBot: [system] reconciliation_report uploaded: s3://redwood-billing/reports/2026-03-25/batch_20260325_03_recon_1872100000.csv
